annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Ghana (Hon. Samuel Nartey George)
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Strategy rests on eight pillars including digital infrastructure and data governance
Emerging Technologies Bill under development to give legal backing for AI
Strengthening NITA, Data Protection Commission and Cyber Security Authority
Ministries to coordinate with the Ministry when designing, procuring and deploying AI; UNDP training of civil service directors June-December 2026
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Opening remarks by Ghana's Communications Minister at the 24 April 2026 launch of the National AI Strategy. They outline eight pillars, planned Emerging Technologies and Data Harmonisation Bills, institutional strengthening, responsible and ethical AI, and next steps such as a delivery roadmap and civil service training.
